name: Signed Quote Comparison
problem: Compare supplier quotations and identify the economically superior comparable option.
deliverable: normalized comparison, ranking, missing-scope findings, source evidence and signed verification packet
proof_of_delivery: signed/hash-bound evidence packet plus independent verification
verification_rules: external buyer + settled payment + fulfillment + independent proof
kill_condition: no external buyer, no settled payment, fulfillment failure, contradictory evidence
